message.content: On April 3rd, 2026, the delivery of bread to Li Hua was handled by Alice. This can be deduced from the content of message number 6 in the sources table, which states, "Time: 20260403_15:00 Alice: I am Alice from Hailey's bakery. Your bread has been delivered, please come and pick it up ASAP. Have a good day : )" Here, Alice identifies herself as the delivery person for the bread that Li Hua received.
